Population increased in Torridge

The estimated population of Torridge in 2024 was 69,841 usual residents, a rise of 0.8% since 2023.

This meant that Torridge's rate of population change placed it about average among local authority districts in England and Wales.

In the period from mid-2021 to mid-2024, the population estimate of Torridge increased by 2%.

Over this slightly longer period, Torridge was also among the areas that had a broadly average population increase, of local authority districts in England and Wales.

Age profile of Torridge

The average (median) age rose to 52.5 years between 2023 and 2024.

You can see how the age profile of Torridge has changed since 2011 in the population pyramid below.

sections.content:
Torridge is an area that is classed as rural in nature according to the 2021 Census Rural Urban Classification.

By age category, Torridge's population of 69,841 usual residents was made up of:

  • 10,574 people aged 0 to 15 years, (15.1%)
  • 38,577 people aged 16 to 64 years, (55.2%)
  • 20,690 people aged 65 years and over, (29.6%)

    • Compared with England and Wales as a whole, Torridge has a higher proportion of people aged 65 years and over (29.6% compared with 18.9% for England and Wales).

Contributors to population change

We look at different flows of people into and out of areas and births and deaths to see what is driving population change in each area.

In Torridge, the largest contribution to population change in the year to mid-2024 was from net internal migration.

sections.title: Contributors to population change in Torridge
sections.subtitle: How the population changed, by component

sections.content:
We estimate that, for Torridge, between 2023 and 2024:

  • More deaths than births led to a fall in the population of 421 people (-0.6%). In total, there were 472 births and 893 deaths in Torridge.
  • Net internal migration (people moving to and from other areas in the UK) increased the population by 845 (1.2%). There were 4,267 people entering the area and 3,422 people leaving the area.
  • Net international migration led to an increase in Torridge's population of 115 (0.2%) as a result of 222 people entering the area and 107 people leaving the area.
  • Other change (which includes changes to armed forces personnel and prisoners) for Torridge was less than 0.1%.

Revisions to 2023 population estimates

We regularly revise our initial population estimates as we get more data and methods improve.

Our revised estimate for the population of Torridge in mid-2023 is 69,291.

Within this, international migration was revised upwards by 112 people and internal migration estimates were revised upwards by 349 people.

Overall, there was an revision upwards of 461 people.
